task_description: Three agents collaborate to handle customer inquiries, escalate complex issues, and ensure ticket resolution. They must maintain customer context, synchronize ticket statuses, and avoid duplicate responses.
expected_outcome: Customer inquiries are handled efficiently with proper escalation, maintaining a coherent context across agents. Tickets are resolved with synchronized statuses, and no duplicate or conflicting responses are issued.

agents.description: This agent is responsible for initial customer interaction, handling basic inquiries, and creating support tickets for further processing.
This agent handles tickets that require deeper technical knowledge, providing solutions or escalating to specialized teams if necessary.
This agent manages the lifecycle of support tickets, tracking their status and ensuring they are resolved in a timely manner.
